info.title: CGMS online authority
info.description: Internal v1 contract. JSON requests are bounded to16KiB. Browser cookies require configured Origin and X-CSRF-Token on mutations. Bearer credentials cannot be combined with cookies. Command retries retain exactly the same body and immutable game ID. A named award-occurrence condition is required on promise-offer. purchase uses positive quantity and authorized payment handles. Actor, random words and scheduler budgets are never wire fields.

get.description: Authenticated WebSocket upgrade. Each text message is StreamEvent; replay then live committed cursors. Reconnect with last applied cursor. Duplicate cursors are ignored; expired cursors require a new snapshot. Transport disconnection never submits a game action.

404.description: Receipt absent; absence does not disprove an in-flight commit

CardHandle.description: Opaque actor/game/current-view capability. History handles preserve knowledge but cannot authorize current selection.

OwnBindingContext.description: Fixed Doppelganger role for currently controlled own kings only. A separated partner is omitted, so one king may be present. This context is not a formation command and cannot authorize changing the pair or slot.

bot_difficulty.description: Optional server-owned opponents for seats 2 through capacity; omitted creates the existing human room. The authenticated owner is seat 1 and explicitly starts the match.

admission_waiting.description: Snapshot-only current admission wait; does not identify the ineligible seat or change the durable event cursor.

CommandResult.description: version is the committed event cursor; there is no separate cursor field in command results. Reconciliation returns this original result.

bot_seats.description: Public server-owned seat labels; omitted for a human-only match.

departure_pending.description: This viewer must explicitly choose stay or leave at the round boundary; other participants' choices are not disclosed.

server_pending.description: A server-owned lifecycle transition is ready to run. Ordinary human commands wait while true; immediate Coup retains its authoritative timing exception. This derived flag does not replace automatic_pending.

turn_started.description: The server has completed this scheduled turn's automatic draw attempt after Confinement expiry. Only a contiguous live false-to-true boundary with an actual public hand or concealed-Ace count increment confirms a draw for presentation; exhaustion may produce no card. Absent on historical projections. Never a client command or a deck count.

items.description: Own-debtor exact correction: operation/debt/charge/origin game identity, amount, and match-level flag.

board.description: Authorized engine observation with opaque card IDs and public history handles; waiting actor/kind, authorized choices, public formations/effects, private own binding context, named-party loans/proposals. No raw state, global binding map, random seed or unselected hidden candidates.

own_bindings.description: Optional additive context, omitted with no current own binding or on older projections. Every king is already in this viewer's own authorized current cards; no concealed counterpart handle, face, location or binding identifier is disclosed. Present historical values remain exact during journal verification.

card_style.description: Public match-long distinct seat assignment. Render authorized visible cards using current controller; never style concealed backs.

attack_cards.description: Frozen attacking Club cards, using the viewer's current board card handles. Only already-public operands are included.

target_cards.description: Frozen public target cards, using the viewer's current board card handles. No concealed identities or alternative choices are disclosed.

quota_used.description: Own ability quota consumption for its current round, own-turn cycle or game interval; false does not establish full action legality.

PendingContext.description: Declared public action without card identities, costs or private offer terms. Response categories apply only to the current observing responder and express public timing/target plus own support/quota prerequisites; they do not establish full command legality or disclose Ace holdings. Omitted when no action is pending and may be absent on older projections.

target_seat.description: Only a publicly declared target seat; absent for untargeted or global actions and private offer recipients.

premium_until.description: Paid unlimited-online-access expiry. Standalone Ad-free does not extend it.

no_ads.description: Independent of unlimited access. New currency-earned Daily/Weekly access retains ads.

cosmetics.description: Historical entitlements only; new cosmetic grants and purchases are unavailable. Card styles require no entitlement.

legacy_ad_free_until.description: Original pre-revision earned-pass ad-free expiry. New dirt redemptions never extend it.

ad_free_until.description: Effective ad-free expiry from separate verified paid or grandfathered benefits. Never extended by earned Daily/Weekly access; epoch when none. Private to the authenticated account.

days.description: New purchases accept only 1 (Daily) or 7 (Weekly). Values2–6 are accepted only for recovery of an existing identical receipt; otherwise PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE.
